'''Janah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who served aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], ''[[Jynni's Virtue]]'', [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Naz Felyood]]. During an attempt to escape an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrol, the freighter and its crew crash-landed on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Not long after, Janah was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Korriban zombie]]s and her corpse was reanimated.
